members.name: Hawker
hardFails: turn flow: each rival chooses whether to recruit during the owner's turn
Turn flow: rivals each choose to buy during your turn.
members.why: Every rival gets a priced shot at a member before you take it free; a table moment, but many words and rivals choose on your turn.

members.name: Shift Crew
members.why: Four followers for four resources and nothing else: dead weight in a color about timing.

members.name: Recruiter
members.why: +1 red per recruit for six resources is a slow trickle that rarely pays back.

members.name: Regular
members.why: +1 blue on follower buys has nothing to do with the shop.

members.name: Volunteer
members.why: Pure filler: a cheap body for recruit triggers and the red count, but nothing happens when it lands.

members.name: Customs Officer
members.why: +1 yellow when stolen from or meddled; reactive, small, rarely fires.

members.name: Critic
members.why: +1 when a rival buys blue: rare and small.

members.name: Heiresses
members.why: Once-per-game white per member at 9; weak and leader-leaning.

members.name: Old Money
members.why: Cost 6 for a Game End per white member count; poor value.

members.name: Timekeeper
members.why: Game End per-purple-member count; quiet and rewards whoever went deepest.

members.name: Dyer
members.why: Tourist's text paying yellow instead of followers: a weaker sibling.

members.name: Busker
members.why: Steady green income: filler.

members.name: Grifter
members.why: Eight resources for a one-off steal sized by your own cult size; overpriced and rewards the big cult.

members.name: Toastmaster
members.why: +1 follower per Silver space; plain and forgettable.

members.name: Patriarch
members.why: A generic member-count scorer, the same shape as Timekeeper and Snobs, rewarding the big cult.

members.name: Snobs
members.why: The same own-color game-end scorer as Timekeeper and Old Money.

members.name: Landlord
members.why: Steady white income: fine filler, nobody notices.

members.name: Caterer
members.why: Pays when silver is "gifted", a word the table has to define across Toast, Potluck and Party Gifts; passive.

members.name: Harmonist
members.why: A game-end full-set scorer: clear, but solo and quiet.

members.name: Roadie
members.why: Income per green member; a small engine.

members.name: Dabblers
members.why: Two wild bodies; strong but what wild counts for takes rulings.

members.name: Philanthropist
members.why: A smaller Largesse on arrival; repeats the spaces.

members.name: Caravan
members.why: A bigger Dyer that pays the already-broad pile more each round; rich-get-richer.

members.name: Agents
members.why: An anti-copy shield, a cheap answer to rival greens more than a green engine.

members.name: Impressionist
members.why: +1 per copy anyone makes; small.

members.name: Jack-of-All-Trades
members.why: Makes full sets easier, which matters only for yellow's contest; quiet.

members.name: Misers
members.why: Pays for holding white at the end against cashing it in: a real hold-or-spend call.

members.name: Money Changers
members.why: Pays on every follower buy at the table; steady and quiet.

members.name: Night Watch
members.why: Punishes rivals for Sleep In and Last Call, but "per minion on it" is unclear: minions on the token or still to place?

members.name: Accomplice
members.why: A one-shot steal 3; a Help Yourself repeat on a card.

members.name: Doormen
members.why: Forcing a swap on a rival every round is Red's job, and the cost rule is long.

members.name: Line Cutters
members.why: Going first every round for 2 resources and 3 followers overrides the catch-up order; a must-buy for the leader.

members.name: Con Men
members.why: Big one-time steal; plain.

members.name: Patroness
members.why: Pays on every bury, which blue does constantly; "per member or per event" needs a ruling.

members.name: Brokers
members.why: +1 on White follower gains; cheap three bodies.

members.name: Deprogrammers
members.why: Good link to the swap cards, but a cost of 3 for 4 followers and 4 red members is an always-buy.

members.name: Smooth Talkers
members.why: Silver becomes any color; a strong engine for the silver leader, nobody else feels it.

members.name: Meddler
members.why: Changing one of each rival's resources can cost them a contest; aim is real, the wording is loose.

members.name: Window Dressers
members.why: Cheap 3-member body with a shop wipe on recruit; a second Out of Style.

members.name: Fence
members.why: Paid when robbed; a soft answer to magenta, little to decide.

members.name: Cashier
members.why: Cash In on a card; strong, repeats the space.

members.name: Extra Hand
members.why: Once-per-game extra minion at cost 9; fine, pricey.

members.name: Extortionist
members.why: Cutpurse doubled at 8; a sibling repeat.

members.name: Proselytizers
members.why: A clean engine that pays every recruit, including red's free ones; nobody else at the table feels it.

members.name: Hostesses
members.why: Silver to every rival each round for followers; a steady gift engine.

members.name: Debt Collectors
members.why: Once-per-game 2 silver from each rival; a contest timing swing.

members.name: High Society
members.why: Paid when rivals take Silver spaces; makes the gifts that pull rivals into silver pay you.

members.name: Window Shopper
members.why: Buries two members each round for their colors; clean denial, but who picks the two must be read.

members.name: Cutpurse
members.why: Small steady steal from the richest; cheap catch-up.

members.name: Kidnapper
members.why: Takes a member from the same rival every round from round I; the victim loses a member early with no answer.

members.name: Shoplifter
members.why: A steal on every recruit; a quiet engine.

members.name: Wallflower
members.why: Doubles copied gains at 10; strong for the copier, leader-leaning.

members.name: Alchemists
members.why: Pay any color for members: a strong unlock for 5, worth 3.

members.name: Mob
members.why: Up to +6 a round for the red leader; rivals can race the red count, but it pays the player already ahead.

members.name: Night Owls
members.why: An extra minion every round from round II is a real rule bend; eight resources is a lot.

members.name: Gardeners
members.why: Fills in the colors you lack, so it helps a thin pile most and feeds full sets.

members.name: Drifters
members.why: Pick a color to count as; feeds red and blue contests and variety cards, needs a marker.

members.name: Gossip
members.why: Pays on every skipped turn, anyone's, so Hold Up and Bouncers build into it.

members.name: Closer
members.why: Pays for going last, which purple already chases; a race for the last minion the table can see.

members.name: Big Tent
members.why: Rewards exactly one member per color; a real shaping goal at game end.

members.name: Trendsetters
members.why: Each recruit churns one shop card, feeding Patroness; a cheap 3-member body.

members.name: Hoarder
members.why: Once-per-game turn everything white, then Cash In; a clear setup play.

members.name: Courier
members.why: Pays on consecutive turns, which purple's spaces make; combos Right Away and Crunch Time.

members.name: Early Birds
members.why: A cheap answer to Hold Up and Bouncers that a first-timer gets at once.

members.name: Hot Streak
members.why: A once-a-game cash-in after a chain of turns; big when set up with Crunch Time, but counting turns in a row takes care.

members.name: Shopaholics
members.why: Two buys every turn is a huge rule bend; strong enough to be the first buy whenever it shows.

members.name: Desperado
members.why: Bigger steals while you trail: built-in catch-up.

members.name: Raiders
members.why: Once-per-game follower steal with a payment; a swing aimed at the leader.

members.name: Impersonator
members.why: Borrow a rival's ability each round; deep, needs a marker.

members.name: Anarchist
members.why: Swap any two members every round; fun for its owner, rough on victims.

members.name: Foster Parents
members.why: Rides on every swap red already does (Promote, Demote, Body Snatchers, Poach) and makes rivals think twice before trading with you.

members.name: Creditor
members.why: Take two followers from the rival you pick and leave them three silver: a fair aimed trade you can point at the leader.

members.name: Tourist
members.why: Followers for holding a spread of colors, every round; a steady scorer that pushes you wide.

members.name: Stunt Double
members.why: Doing your action twice on recruit makes you time your best space with the buy.

members.name: Mentor & Protégés
members.why: Two recruits for one buy, chains into Proselytizers and Recruiter; nine resources for a 3 is steep.

members.name: Loyalists
members.why: A clear block against red's swaps and Body Snatchers; rivals see it and aim elsewhere.

members.name: Debutantes
members.why: Once-per-game double silver with a gift attached; a timing call around the contest.

members.name: Guest of Honor
members.why: Every Silver space can turn a cheap member into +4 followers, linking to Godparent, Old Maid and Foster Parents; strong for a cost of 3.

members.name: Bodyguards
members.why: Rivals can't steal from you; a clean wall, but it turns magenta off against you.

members.name: Double Agent
members.why: Pay 8 to trade itself for any rival's member; a clever swap.

members.name: Recluse
members.why: Game End per wider rival; catch-up for a small cult.

members.name: Tribute Band
members.why: Do everything a rival did this round once: a huge moment, with fourteen resources the barrier.

members.name: Old Maid
members.why: A hot potato for Godparent, Guest of Honor and Double Agent; the table laughs when it moves.

members.name: Sore Loser
members.why: Steal from the top contest winner when you win none; real catch-up.

members.name: Doppelganger
members.why: Becomes your best member: clear, and better with the cards around it.

members.name: Encore
members.why: Doubles one On Recruit; timing the big one is a real choice.

members.name: Panel
members.why: A swap on recruit that combos with Foster Parents and Deprogrammers; "promote or demote" asks a new player to know two spaces.

members.name: Bouncers
members.why: Skipping the next two rivals on recruit is a table moment with timing to choose, and feeds Gossip.

members.name: Godparent
members.why: Give a member away for its cost in followers; pairs with Old Maid, Martyrs and Foster Parents across colors.

members.name: Fan Club
members.why: Copies what the leader took: a clean catch-up hook.

members.name: Spoilsport
members.why: Cancels a contest you can't win; a block aimed at the leader.

members.name: Body Snatchers
members.why: Every round you pick a rival member of the same cost to trade for; clear, aimed, feeds Foster Parents and Deprogrammers, and Loyalists answer it.

members.name: Second-Story Man
members.why: A steal right before contests are scored can flip one; a timed, aimed sting you can see coming.

members.name: Party Crasher
members.why: Once a game you get into the space that was already taken; a rule bend everyone feels.

members.name: Martyrs
members.why: Leaving pays you its cost, so a rival's Poach or swap backfires and your own Farewell pays twice; plays off many colors.

spaces.name: Shake Down
hardFails: turn flow: the rival chooses a member and a payment during the owner's turn
Turn flow: the victim chooses their member during your turn.
spaces.why: The victim chooses their own punishment, which feels bad, and the wording is long.

spaces.name: Potluck
hardFails: turn flow: each rival chooses a resource to give during the owner's turn
Turn flow: each rival chooses what to give during your turn.
spaces.why: Every rival pays one resource and gets two silver: a fair trade but small, and each rival has to choose on your turn.

spaces.name: Stash
spaces.why: The shared fuel-plus-recruit-bonus template again; nothing magenta.

spaces.name: Allowance
spaces.why: The shared fuel-plus-recruit-bonus template; nothing white.

spaces.name: Polish
spaces.why: Converter; useful glue, no moment.

spaces.name: Gather
spaces.why: Clear plain anchor with a recruit kicker; nobody else notices, and it is the same text as Stash and Allowance.

spaces.name: Exchange
spaces.why: Resources into followers on a sliding cap; fine, a bit fiddly.

spaces.name: Build Up
spaces.why: The plain fuel anchor.

spaces.name: Estate Sale
spaces.why: Farewell paying white instead of followers: a weaker sibling.

spaces.name: Bury
spaces.why: A smaller Savings; the half-cost blue payout is a sum to work out.

spaces.name: Harvest
spaces.why: The plain fuel anchor, in any colors, which fits a color about going broad.

spaces.name: New Blood
spaces.why: Recruit-bonus template with a yellow twist (a new color); fine.

spaces.name: Melting Pot
spaces.why: Pays for how broad you already are, which rewards the wide cult more than the one behind.

spaces.name: Demote
spaces.why: Mirror of Promote that trades down; the downgrade is rarely what you want, so it mostly lives as a weaker sibling or a Foster Parents trigger.

spaces.name: Right Away
spaces.why: A small double turn; clean, mostly a tempo tool.

spaces.name: Tryout
spaces.why: Borrows any shop card's On Recruit without buying it; reads clean, links every color, and keeps the card for someone else.

spaces.name: Leaders' Tax
spaces.why: Pays by where rivals sit; reads the board but small.

spaces.name: Savings
spaces.why: Fuel plus a bury before buying; a small deny.

spaces.name: Splurge
spaces.why: Big followers on a pricey recruit, but the per-2 then per-1 math is a sum to work out.

spaces.name: Peek
spaces.why: A good scaling gain and your pick of the pile; private, so nobody else reacts.

spaces.name: Walk-In
spaces.why: A free member in round I is a big moment, and the +1 red to each rival is a small gift the table sees.

spaces.name: Sleep In
spaces.why: Big purple plus a claim on Went Last that rivals can take back; the token takes a read.

spaces.name: Last Call
spaces.why: A big payoff for holding minions back, at the cost of going last; the token rules make it a read.

spaces.name: Toast
spaces.why: A big silver gain with a visible gift to everyone; a clean anchor for the giving color.

spaces.name: Lie Low
spaces.why: Small steal plus a round of safety; a block players see.

spaces.name: Sample
spaces.why: Borrow a rival's On Recruit; a clever link, needs a scan of rivals' cards.

spaces.name: Initiation
spaces.why: Round III burst anyone can grab: a free member up to 8, plain and powerful.

spaces.name: Hold Up
spaces.why: The skip lands on whoever is next, even you, so timing is a real call and the victim can see it coming.

spaces.name: Overtime
spaces.why: A round III extra minion: plain, and a burst any player can use.

spaces.name: Heist
spaces.why: Three followers off the leader: plain, felt, a catch-up tool.

spaces.name: Farewell
spaces.why: Cast out a member for its cost in followers; a clean white trade that combos Martyrs.

spaces.name: Sweet Nothings
spaces.why: You give your own silver to get two of any color back each: a real hold-versus-give call on the silver contest.

spaces.name: Cash In
spaces.why: The round III cash-out the white pile builds toward.

spaces.name: Promote
spaces.why: The signature red swap: you trade up out of a rival's cult; strong aim choice, the victim still gets a member back.

spaces.name: Housewarming
spaces.why: A free member in a new color: the yellow idea in one line.

spaces.name: Makeover
spaces.why: Rearrange everything in round III to finish sets and swing held-color contests.

spaces.name: Recruit Twice
spaces.why: Two recruits in one turn; plain and big.

spaces.name: Reprise
spaces.why: Copy your own best action again: clean and grows through the game.

spaces.name: Cover
spaces.why: Copy an open space; a way around blocks, clean.

spaces.name: Greatest Hits
spaces.why: Replay every On Recruit you own; the round III payoff for building them.

spaces.name: Party Gifts
spaces.why: Six followers for gifting three silver, with a real call about who you feed in the silver contest; strong for round I.

spaces.name: Out of Style
spaces.why: Clears a whole color out of the shop: denial the table sees, and it feeds Patroness.

spaces.name: Crunch Time
spaces.why: Three turns in a row: a big change to the snake in few words, and it sets up Courier and Hot Streak.

spaces.name: Spree
spaces.why: Three recruits in round III is the burst a trailing player can grab.

spaces.name: Help Yourself
spaces.why: The core steal, scaling by round, aimed where it hurts the leader.

spaces.name: Poach
spaces.why: The round III member grab; clear, felt, and Martyrs and Loyalists-style answers exist.

spaces.name: Echo
spaces.why: Copy the previous action: scales with the board, few words.

spaces.name: Largesse
spaces.why: Round III big gift-for-followers that also hands rivals contest silver; clear and dramatic.
